doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27

title: Looking at an 1896 photo; Laine's fancy uniform
summary: They find a faded 1896 photo of the band, and Laine says he refused the heavily decorated uniform the major offered.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
